1: // Simple top‑down endless runner for canvas with id "game"
2: // Ship (player) avoids asteroids, collects power‑ups
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   // size canvas to its CSS size
8:   const resize = () => {
9:     canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
10:     canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
11:   };
12:   resize();
13:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
14: 
15:   // player ship
16:   const player = {
17:     x: canvas.width / 2,
18:     y: canvas.height - 60,
19:     size: 20,
20:     speed: 4,
21:     dx: 0,
22:     dy: 0,
23:   };
24:   const keys = {};
25:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
26:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
27: 
28:   // asteroids and power‑ups
29:   const asteroids = [];
30:   const powerUps = [];
31:   let spawnTimer = 0;
32:   let puTimer = 0;
33:   let score = 0;
34:   let gameOver = false;
35: 
36:   const rnd = (min, max) => Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
37: 
38:   const spawnAsteroid = () => {
39:     const radius = rnd(10, 30);
40:     asteroids.push({
41:       x: rnd(radius, canvas.width - radius),
42:       y: -radius,
43:       r: radius,
44:       speed: rnd(1, 3) + score * 0.005,
45:     });
46:   };
47: 
48:   const spawnPowerUp = () => {
49:     const size = 12;
50:     powerUps.push({
51:       x: rnd(size, canvas.width - size),
52:       y: -size,
53:       size,
54:       speed: 2,
55:     });
56:   };
57: 
58:   const updatePlayer = () => {
59:     player.dx = 0; player.dy = 0;
60:     if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) player.dx = -player.speed;
61:     if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) player.dx = player.speed;
62:     if (keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['w']) player.dy = -player.speed;
63:     if (keys['ArrowDown'] || keys['s']) player.dy = player.speed;
64:     player.x = Math.max(player.size, Math.min(canvas.width - player.size, player.x + player.dx));
65:     player.y = Math.max(player.size, Math.min(canvas.height - player.size, player.y + player.dy));
66:   };
67: 
68:   const rectCircleCollide = (rx, ry, rw, rh, cx, cy, cr) => {
69:     const distX = Math.abs(cx - rx - rw / 2);
70:     const distY = Math.abs(cy - ry - rh / 2);
71:     if (distX > rw / 2 + cr) return false;
72:     if (distY > rh / 2 + cr) return false;
73:     if (distX <= rw / 2) return true;
74:     if (distY <= rh / 2) return true;
75:     const dx = distX - rw / 2;
76:     const dy = distY - rh / 2;
77:     return dx * dx + dy * dy <= cr * cr;
78:   };
79: 
80:   const update = () => {
81:     if (gameOver) return;
82:     spawnTimer++;
83:     if (spawnTimer > 60) { spawnAsteroid(); spawnTimer = 0; }
84:     puTimer++;
85:     if (puTimer > 500) { spawnPowerUp(); puTimer = 0; }
86:     updatePlayer();
87:     // move asteroids
88:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
89:       const a = asteroids[i];
90:       a.y += a.speed;
91:       if (a.y - a.r > canvas.height) { asteroids.splice(i, 1); score++; continue; }
92:       // collision with player (approx ship as rectangle)
93:       if (rectCircleCollide(player.x - player.size, player.y - player.size, player.size * 2, player.size * 2, a.x, a.y, a.r)) {
94:         gameOver = true;
95:       }
96:     }
97:     // move power‑ups
98:     for (let i = powerUps.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
99:       const p = powerUps[i];
100:       p.y += p.speed;
101:       if (p.y - p.size > canvas.height) { powerUps.splice(i, 1); continue; }
102:       // collect
103:       if (rectCircleCollide(player.x - player.size, player.y - player.size, player.size * 2, player.size * 2, p.x, p.y, p.size)) {
104:         player.speed += 0.5; // temporary boost
105:         powerUps.splice(i, 1);
106:         score += 5;
107:       }
108:     }
109:   };
110: 
111:   const draw = () => {
112:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
113:     // player ship (triangle)
114:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
115:     ctx.beginPath();
116:     ctx.moveTo(player.x, player.y - player.size);
117:     ctx.lineTo(player.x - player.size, player.y + player.size);
118:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.size, player.y + player.size);
119:     ctx.closePath();
120:     ctx.fill();
121:     // asteroids
122:     ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
123:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
124:       ctx.beginPath();
125:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
126:       ctx.fill();
127:     });
128:     // power‑ups
129:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
130:     powerUps.forEach(p => {
131:       ctx.beginPath();
132:       ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
133:       ctx.fill();
134:     });
135:     // UI
136:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
137:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
138:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
139:     if (gameOver) {
140:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
141:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
142:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
143:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
144:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
145:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
146:     }
147:   };
148: 
149:   const loop = () => {
150:     update();
151:     draw();
152:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
153:   };
154:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
155: })();

(End of file - total 155 lines)
</content>
